name: Fire Wallet
long_description:
🔥FIRE WALLET 🔥

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JeXDDegwhgA

TL;DR: Fire Wallet is a fast, end-to-end encrypted, non-custodial stablecoin wallet with built-in payment processing and fiat on/off ramps, built by the team that created MobileCoin, the cryptocurrency inside Signal.

Hey Bookface! We're Josh, Michael, and Manny and we're building Fire Wallet!

🔥Why we built this

Most wallets and payment processors don’t work FOR you. They're slow, route your payments in the way that earns them the most, and they leak your financial life to anyone asking. Worse: every single one hold the keys to your money.

We believe your financial tools should act in your interest and, frankly, that your money should be yours.

 🔥What Fire does

Multi-chain, non-custodial, end-to-end encrypted wallet. 
Your keys, your money, your assets: you are in full control of your funds at all times. 
Least Cost Routing. Every swap and payment takes the cheapest path, not the one that pays a middleman the most.
Self-sovereign payment processing. Send an invoice straight from the wallet. Get paid from your web checkout. No middleman.
Easy fiat on/off ramps. Move stablecoins to USD and back without the pain.
Built for agentic commerce. Manage per-agent sub-wallets for agentic workflows.
Encrypted by default. Protecting you from bad actors and surveillance capitalism.

🔥Early traction

Signed our first major LOI with @Trustboop (founded by Justice Laub of Drone Racing League and Rob Rhinehart of Soylent).

Onboarding our first enterprise customer in ecommerce packaging and marketing, doing about $1.5M/month in volume. They've connected us to 10 more companies in the same vertical at similar volume, roughly a $100M/yr GMV opportunity.

🔥Why us

Josh and Manuel led the creation of MobileCoin, the cryptocurrency in Signal Messenger: $100M+ raised, $1.16B peak valuation, $4B+ peak coin market cap, acquired in 2026. They understand what it takes to build a cryptographic business.

Michael runs product and design. He's an internationally exhibited artist with two published art books, and he builds beautiful products.

Manuel runs operations and orchestrates systems that actually work at scale.

🔥Asks

Intros to businesses moving $1M+/month in payments, especially cross-border, ecommerce, and DTC, who want lower fees and more control over their funds.

Strategic partners in fintech and payments interested in integrating our infrastructure.
Tell us what's broken. Reply here or email founders@fire.co.

We're looking for our first 100 customers. If that's you or someone you know, we'd love to talk.

launches.tagline: The wallet Satoshi Nakamoto and William Gibson would've built
launches.body:
<https://youtu.be/8raKMw5p1nU>

## **🔥 FIRE WALLET: THE LAST CRYPTO WALLET 🔥**

**You are not data.**

Fire Wallet builds commerce tools for our agentic future.

Agents are beginning to pay for things on our behalf but today's payment infrastructure wasn't designed for autonomous software.

Credit cards expose broad spending authority. Processing fees make tiny payments impractical. Blockchains leave your transaction history out in the open.

**_Fire Wallet_** _changes that._

Using its own wallet, an agent can make a simple API call, pay a fraction of a cent in transaction fees, and move on. No card numbers, no processor taking a percentage, and no public record of who paid whom or how much.

**Self-custodied funds, programmable privacy, and efficient payments for a better tomorrow.**

## **🔥 How it works**

Giving an agent money takes a few seconds:

1. **Add:** Scan its QR code or enter its link to pair it.
2. **Fund:** Choose an amount and a time limit.
3. **Go:** Your wallet creates a separate account and gives the agent its own key.

The agent never sees your other accounts and it can't spend more than what's in its own account. When you revoke the agent’s account, unspent funds return to your wallet. You can even upload an .md file with per-agent rules.

BTW: We can do this for your merchant checkout too!! \
Ask us how you can have a self-sovereign Shopify/Stripe checkout experience!!

## **🔥 Why Fire wins**

* **Controlled:** Agents can only spend the money you give them.
* **Efficient:** Payments cost a quarter of a cent, regardless of size.
* **Private:** Payment amounts, senders, and recipients are encrypted.
* **Non-custodial:** Your money. Your keys. Agents only access their own accounts.
* **Cross-device visibility:** Every payment appears in Fire Wallet on iPhone, Chrome, and Mac Desktop _(Single Unified Wallet Infra with non-custodial private key management)._
* **Revocable:** Top up or revoke an agent's account whenever you want.

**🔥 Who we are**

We are Joshua, Michael, and Manny. Joshua and Manny created MobileCoin, the private cryptocurrency integrated into Signal Messenger _(>$100M raised, $1.16B peak equity valuation, >$4B peak coin valuation, acquired: 2026)_. Michael leads Fire's product and design. Manny is head of operations.

We've spent years making private digital payments fast, efficient, and easy to use. Now we're bringing that infrastructure to AI agents.

## **🔥 We're looking for**

* **Agent developers** with agents that need to pay for things.
* **API, data, and compute providers** who want to accept payments as small as pennies.
* **Teams building agent frameworks and MCP tooling** who want native payment capabilities.

If you're building in this space, we'd love to talk.

Reply here or email [founders@fire.co](mailto:founders@fire.co).

Built by the team behind MobileCoin, the cryptocurrency inside Signal.

**Privacy is dignity.**

<https://fire.co>
